title: Reference The Attached Copy Of Jen Ti Mei Human Body Beautiful

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. 66
No. D
Special Branch Pag 5. xxxxxx /
REPORT
Date. March 19, 19 35.
Subject Reference the attached copy of Jen Ti Mei (人体美 Human Body Beautiful).
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder.

The attached booklet contains nothing upon which
a prosecution could be based under the present circumstances.
The majority of the prints are taken from
European art gallery catalogues, whilst the reading matter
consists merely of explanations of the work and methods
of European artists.
Such books as the attached are sold every where,
ostensibly for the use of students of European art, however,
there is no doubt that they are usually purchased for other
purposes than study.

Em Golder
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).
File
JMS
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科登记处。
档案编号 66
D 号
特别科第 5 页。xxxxxx /
报告
日期：1935 年 3 月 19 日。
事由：关于随附的《人体美》（Jen Ti Mei）副本。
由副督察长 Golder 撰写并呈报。

在目前情况下，随附的小册子中没有任何内容可作为起诉的依据。
大多数图片取自欧洲艺术画廊的目录，而文字部分仅仅是对欧洲艺术家作品及创作方法的解说。

诸如随附此类书籍到处均有销售，表面上是供欧洲艺术学生使用，然而，毫无疑问，人们购买它们通常并非为了学习目的。

Em Golder
副督察长

特别科助理总监。
归档
JMS
